name: ND Nr. 34 Oak at the Nummernweiher, Volkspark Dutzendteich

location.address: Volkspark Dutzendteich, north shore of the eastern Nummernweiher, Nuremberg

verified_sources: data/registers/bayern-naturdenkmale.json ND-05060 (Bavarian Naturdenkmal register, status aktuell)
access: Free. Public city park (Volkspark Dutzendteich), open all hours; the tree stands on the lake's north shore.
transport: Tram 4 terminus or S-Bahn Dutzendteich, roughly 10 minutes on foot (estimate, stop-to-park distance not measured)
verify_notes: Register only (Bavarian Naturdenkmal register, row ND-05060, 'aktuell'; Nuremberg's own 2020 ordinance list per earlier pass). Register coordinate 49.428955,11.109193 and de.wikipedia's list coordinate 49.42894,11.10923 agree within about 3 m, and a Commons photograph of this exact monument is geotagged at the same point, so the pin is confirmed to tree level. Species: de.wikipedia list and the photographer's Commons category 'Quercus robur in Nuremberg' (the species label is the Commons contributor's, not the register's; the register says only 'Eiche'). Photograph in hand: Commons file 'Eiche im Volkspark Dutzendteich am Nordufer des oestlichen Nummernweihers.jpg' (found by lifecheck, dated 2019-06-20; licence not yet checked here, a photo pass must verify it). Alive: lifecheck gave OLD (2019) only; no vitality field in register; deliver flagged. No girth, height or age given by any source seen. Part of a walkable group around the Dutzendteich lakes with ND 33 and ND 31 (all within roughly 450 m).
